# Job Listings
Your [color=#ff0000]employers[/color] have provided you with a job listings app hidden inside your uplink. Each job listing is a mini-objective you can complete for a small reward, like extra telecrystals or sometimes even an uplink item. The more side jobs you do, the more your reputation within the syndicate will grow, and the tougher and more rewarding your work will be. Eventually, they may ask you to undertake a mission so daring that it will guarantee you go down in history as a [color=#ff0000]Living Legend[/color].
Do you think you have what it takes?
